data.name: TankFall Arena
data.detailed_description:
Overview

TankFall Arena is a retro-inspired top-down tank combat game where every wall can become a weapon.

Master ricochets, control powerful weapon pickups, and outmaneuver enemy tanks across randomized battlefields filled with obstacles, hazards, and unpredictable combat situations. A perfectly planned bank shot can eliminate an opponent hiding behind cover, while a careless bounce can send your own projectile right back at you.

Play solo against AI opponents or battle with friends in local multiplayer as you experiment with different weapons, utilities, team configurations, and arena layouts.

In TankFall Arena, the battlefield is constantly changing, and survival depends on creativity just as much as aim.

Every Wall Is Part Of The Fight

Unlike traditional arena shooters, projectiles don't simply disappear when they hit a wall.

Bounce shots around corners.

Create impossible angles.

Punish enemies hiding behind cover.

Turn defensive positions into deadly traps.

The best players learn to see opportunities where others only see walls.

Weapons That Change How You Fight

Control an expanding arsenal of weapons designed around completely different combat styles.

Current weapon drops include:

  • Standard Cannon

  • Laser

  • Minigun

  • Frag Bomb

Each weapon rewards different positioning, timing, and battlefield awareness.

Some excel at direct pressure.

Others dominate through ricochets, area control, or sustained fire.

Utilities And Battlefield Control

Weapon pickups are only part of the equation.

Utilities introduce new tactical options and mobility tools that can dramatically alter how a battle unfolds.

Current utility:

  • Grappling Hook

Additional utilities are planned throughout development.

Fight Across Randomized Battlefields

No two matches play exactly the same.

Randomized terrain generation creates new combat situations every game, forcing players to adapt rather than memorize maps.

Different wall layouts create new ricochet angles, defensive positions, chokepoints, and opportunities for creative plays.

Solo, Co-op, And Competitive Local Multiplayer

Play the way you want.

  • Single-player matches against AI tanks

  • Team battles

  • Free-for-all battles

  • Local multiplayer

  • Steam Remote Play Together support

Whether you're practicing trick shots alone or competing with friends, every match becomes its own battlefield puzzle.

Configure Your Own Battles

Customize match settings and experiment with different combat scenarios.

Adjust player counts.

Create team-based matches.

Mix human and AI players.

Test weapons and utilities.

Build the tank battle you want to play.

Early Development

TankFall Arena is actively being developed.

Planned updates include:

  • Additional weapons

  • New utilities

  • More arena content

  • Expanded bot behaviors

  • New gameplay systems

  • Additional multiplayer features

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any compatible sound device
